title: SIMON
description: A visual walkthrough of peer-to-peer inference, signed output receipts, hardware comparisons and the limits of verification.
summary: Explains how jobs move between clients and nodes, how signed receipts bind outputs, and what performance experiments show. Distinguishes output integrity from proof of model execution.
note: Team research project · Video created to explain the system and recorded experiments.

title: Canary MLOps
description: An animated explanation of model registration, canary traffic, monitoring and promotion or rollback.
summary: Follows a model through registration and limited candidate traffic, shows monitoring panels, and explains when a deployment can be promoted or rolled back.
note: Architecture explainer · Illustrative metric panels are not production performance evidence.

title: Water Tank
description: A motion-graphics presentation of water-level control, failure scenarios and an independent shutdown proposal.
summary: Shows normal pump hysteresis, sensor and pump failure scenarios, an independent high-level trip, and a proposed stopping test with residual overflow risks.
note: Classroom design proposal · Thresholds and stopping tests are proposed, not measured results.
